title: Probabilities on Finite Models
author: Ronald Fagin
version: Original Journal of Symbolic Logic 41(1), March 1976, pp. 50-58; author-hosted scan, not a later replacement
required_extent: Sections 1-4, printed pp. 50-58, including section 4(7) on printed p.58
read_extent: Full extracted text of all nine pages; original page images for printed pp.51,52,53,56,57,58 inspected to verify lost formulas and critical distinctions
proof_boundaries: Theorem 1 is explicitly sketched in original; annex supplies an editorial full expansion using standard first-order compactness and downward Lowenheim-Skolem.
Theorem 2 prints only binary estimate; annex supplies arbitrary positive finite arities.
Theorem 8 and geometric enumeration rate are imported in original from IBM report RC5587, August 1975; separate report proof not acquired or reconstructed here.
Section 4(7) convergence theorem is explicitly stated without proof in original; reader entry retains cited status.
